# sendgrid_bounce_purge_mail_settings (Resource)

Manages the account-wide bounce purge mail setting, which controls automatic purging of contacts from bounce suppression lists after a number of days. This is a singleton: SendGrid has exactly one bounce purge configuration per account (or per subuser, via the provider's `on_behalf_of`); creating this resource updates that configuration in place, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state without resetting SendGrid's setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_bounce_purge_mail_settings" "this" {
  enabled      = true
  soft_bounces = 7
  hard_bounces = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the bounce purge mail setting is enabled.

### Optional

- `hard_bounces` (Number) The number of days after which SendGrid purges contacts from the hard bounces suppression list.
- `soft_bounces` (Number) The number of days after which SendGrid purges contacts from the soft bounces suppression list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `bounce_purge_mail_settings`.
